Sound familiar?

Looking for a dentist you can stick with?

Whether it’s been six months or several years, you’ll be welcomed without judgement.

It’s been a while since your last check-up

We focus on understanding your oral health now and helping you move forward comfortably.

You feel nervous about the dentist

Appointments are unhurried, everything is explained clearly, and you’re always in control.

You’ve just moved to the area

A friendly private practice in Newport Pagnell, with free on-site parking.

You want to know the cost first

One clear price for your check-up, and every fee explained before treatment goes ahead.

You need a dentist for the whole family

Care for adults and children, under one roof.

Something doesn’t feel quite right

Pain, swelling or a damaged tooth? We offer emergency appointments, and early attention helps.

Your check-up is a thorough look at your oral health, followed by clear advice and a plan built around you.

What’s included

A proper check-up, explained clearly.

We assess your teeth, gums, bite and soft tissues, review your gum health and screen for oral cancer, all for a fixed fee of £85.

Time to talk

Nervous or have questions? We take the time to listen and explain everything clearly, so you feel at ease.

Your check-up, step by step.

01.
Book your appointment

02.

03.
Clear advice

04.
Your treatment plan

Leave with tailored recommendations and next steps, with no pressure and no hidden fees.
